 For Petitioner : Mr.S.Vikram,
 For R1 : Mr.R.M.Anbunithi,

 ORDER Muthusivakarthick vs The State Of Tamilnadu on 8 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/157596410/
1

The petitioner seeks to set aside the order passed by the learned Sessions Judge (FAC), Mahalir Neethimandram (Fast Track Mahila Court), Theni, in Crl.M.P.No.651 of 2024 in S.C.No.93 of 2021,
dated 16.04.2025, by which the petitioner's application under Section 311 Cr.P.C for the recall of the witness P.W1 was dismissed.

2.The learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the petitioner is facing trial for the offences under Sections 449, 376(2), 376(d), 354(c), 506(2) of IPC and Sections 67 and 67(A) of IT Act and that if the petitioner is not permitted to cross-examine P.W1, his valuable right to a fair trial would be denied.
3.The learned Additional Public Prosecutor would submit that the case is now posted for the examination of L.W11, L.W14 and L.W15 and that petition has been filed only to delay the trial and sought for dismissal of the petition.
4 . T h o u g h t h i s c o u r t f i n d s t h a t t h e r e a s o n f o r t h e r e c a l l o f w i t n e s s e s https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 29/10/2025 11:33:33 am ) stated by the petitioner is not convincing, one more opportunity can be given to the petitioner to cross examine the witness,
considering the fact that PW1 is an important witness and the prosecution case has still not been closed.

Hence, the impugned order dated 16.04.2025 is set aside with the following directions:
(i) The petitioner shall be permitted to recall PW.1 on the same day fixed by the learned Sessions Judge on payment of a cost of Rs.3000/- and further the petitioner shall deposit a sum of Rs.2000/- to the District legal Services Authority, Theni.
(ii) If the petitioner fails to comply with the above direction, the order passed by this Court shall stand vacated without further reference to this Court.
5.With the above directions, this Criminal Original Petition is allowed.
